name: Torrumbarry Weir
notes: 18,000 (informal operating constraint); 23,000 (trial to lift the constraint, 2021); Koondrook-Perricoota forest inflows start at about 15,000-18,000 and creeks flow at about 20,000; The informal constraint was reviewed in Sept 2021; I did not find whether it was formally changed
source: Victorian Environmental Water Holder review and trial (via search summary); Koondrook-Perricoota environmental water delivery document (2011) and flood enhancement project assessment

name: Mid Goulburn River
notes: not found; A release limit of 10,000-15,000 downstream of the Acheron was modelled, giving about 35,000 at Trawool and 40,000 at Seymour and Murchison (2014 sensitivity run, not a recommended rule); Delivery of 25,000-40,000 to the lower Goulburn is limited mainly to avoid flooding in the mid-Goulburn; check current operating rules
source: MDBA priority constraints analysis (Dec 2014); Goulburn Constraints Business Case hydrology analysis (via search summaries)

name: Lower Goulburn River
notes: 8,500 operational delivery limit (2017 business case); 25,000-40,000 constrained under operational management; Up to 40,000 (upper bound for investigation); 17,000 possible in-channel target (2017); 2022-23 floods set gauge records (150,000 at Murchison, 107,000 at McCoys Bridge); figures predate that and later decisions
source: New Goulburn Constraints Measure business case (Aug 2017); MDBA priority constraints analysis (Dec 2014) (via search summaries)
